transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get next week's sustainment-training board published by 1600 today, so let's work through any issues now. The board includes the driver-certification block and the radio-procedures refresher for support personnel. I need the S-3 and motor pool chief to report any schedule changes, readiness changes, or required administrative controls before I sign the final board. Are there any issues with the training yard availability or the training trucks for the driver-certification block?

transcript.text: Sir, I need to flag a schedule conflict. transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a readiness change affecting the driver-certification block. During this morning's inspection I confirmed that only four of the six assigned training trucks have completed brake inspections. The other two trucks will not be released until Friday at 0800, and this inspection status has not yet been posted to the training board. Those two trucks must remain on hold until their inspections are complete. If the driver-certification block is scheduled for Tuesday morning as routine, we'll only have four trucks available instead of the standard six.
